BlackRock MuniAssets Fund Announces Dividend The firm also recently disclosed a monthly dividend, which will be paid on Tuesday, December 22nd. Investors of record on Friday, December 11th will be issued a $0.0555 dividend. This represents a $0.67 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 7.0%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, December 11th. BlackRock MuniAssets Fund Company Profile ( Get Free Report ) BlackRock MuniAssets Fund, Inc NYSE: MUA is a closed-end management investment company managed by BlackRock Advisors, LLC. The fund seeks to provide investors with current income that is exempt from regular federal income tax by investing primarily in municipal bonds and other tax-exempt municipal obligations.

The fund's portfolio may include bonds issued by states, cities, counties, municipalities and other public entities across the United States. These securities generally finance public infrastructure and services, such as transportation, utilities, education, healthcare and housing.
